independent_synthetic_core.baseline_prompt_en: Independent synthetic baseline declares actual existing object O, actual chair C, and existing selected participant endpoints P and Q. Each independently has neutral entity presence. C has exact chair type. O/C and P/Q are explicitly disjoint. No object/chair placement, propped state, contact, counterpart role or chair association is already frozen; all are selected effects with composition/role/relationship open. These independent declarations are synthetic, not real requester or runtime evidence.
